milestones.title: V2 contracts, schemas, Git genesis, and seed boundary

exit_criteria.claim: Every v2 registry, packet, envelope, manifest, and receipt validates without silently accepting unknown fields.
exit_criteria.hollow_control: unknown field and wrong-version fixtures fail nonzero

exit_criteria.claim: A generated v2 product is a Git repo with reproducible genesis and can verify its seed boundary offline in a fresh clone.
exit_criteria.hollow_control: missing .git or mutated seed-manifest member fails

exit_criteria.claim: Observed graph is bound to commit/tree and reports every missing required edge, unexpected edge, owner drift, closure leak, and opaque blind spot.
exit_criteria.hollow_control: remove one load-bearing edge while preserving filenames

exit_criteria.claim: The declared observation closure is sufficient for terminal-slice and repo-level invariants without claiming universal perception.
exit_criteria.hollow_control: projection with an unreported dynamic edge is rejected

milestones.title: Work-Item, capability packet, and terminal envelope

exit_criteria.claim: One Work-Item binds one terminal slice, one declared path closure, one oracle set, and at most one candidate commit without storing mutable status.
exit_criteria.hollow_control: scope or criterion drift under the same packet hash fails

exit_criteria.claim: The capability packet and envelope bundle validates and dry-runs in a clean offline clone without the mother repo.
exit_criteria.hollow_control: remove an embedded manifest binding and rerun

exit_criteria.claim: Reason, perceive, and execute skills operate standalone and each rejects mutation or authority outside its declared role.
exit_criteria.hollow_control: each skill attempts one forbidden action and receives typed failure

exit_criteria.claim: The reason skill still executes exactly twenty dependency-valid, non-constant local functions over the repo evidence.
exit_criteria.hollow_control: twenty constant-return handlers fail semantic behavior

exit_criteria.claim: CQ-0 runs minimum lineage, changed-path format/lint, strict affected project closure, dependency boundary, and focused behavior before candidate commit.
exit_criteria.hollow_control: one failing fixture per CQ-0 stage leaves HEAD unchanged

exit_criteria.claim: Affected closure matches full-repo detection for cross-project imports; uncertain closure records fallback and checks the full repo.
exit_criteria.hollow_control: change upstream package and break downstream consumer

milestones.title: Candidate molecular commit card and minimum lineage

exit_criteria.claim: A candidate commit is accepted only after CQ-0 and its seven stable index-card fields bind prompt roles, oracles, packet, and evidence without absolute paths.
exit_criteria.hollow_control: missing field, stale hash, absolute path, or extra scope fails

exit_criteria.claim: Commit cards are deterministic retrieval inputs and never embed volatile async pending/pass state.
exit_criteria.hollow_control: volatile axis trailer is rejected

milestones.title: Append-only attestation refs and freshness projection

exit_criteria.claim: Retries create distinct attestation refs and no earlier observation can be overwritten or relabelled stale.
exit_criteria.hollow_control: second publish to identical ref with different bytes fails

exit_criteria.claim: A changed candidate, tree, profile, or oracle set prevents reuse and derives pending or repair_required.
exit_criteria.hollow_control: copy passing attestation from another commit

exit_criteria.claim: Work-Item identity survives Forgejo outage; candidate commit succeeds locally, while merge/release/admit remains blocked until readback closes.
exit_criteria.hollow_control: Forgejo unavailable and forged issue number cannot admit

exit_criteria.claim: The live local Forgejo operation and exact readback are accepted as a projection of the same Work-Item and candidate.
exit_criteria.hollow_control: mismatched issue body or candidate hash is rejected

milestones.title: Derived progress, drift, and bounded repair prompts

exit_criteria.claim: Deleting projections and replaying the same registries, Git, attestations, and readbacks yields byte-identical progress and prompt outputs.
exit_criteria.hollow_control: hand-edited status cannot advance progress

exit_criteria.claim: Only same-slice, same-criteria, expected-HEAD, allowed-path drift yields an automatic repair; expansion yields a human-required proposal.
exit_criteria.hollow_control: new dependency or path is never silently auto-authorized

exit_criteria.claim: Both backends run the same commit/Work-Item/attestation queries and report retrieval quality, provenance coverage, rebuild, update locality, p95, RSS, and disk.
exit_criteria.hollow_control: a backend that cannot rebuild or preserve provenance is ineligible

exit_criteria.claim: The selected backend's Bun/Node runtime and native packaging requirements match verified primary-source and local execution evidence.
exit_criteria.hollow_control: documentation-only support without local run stays candidate

exit_criteria.claim: Human admits LanceDB only if it wins the declared Pareto comparison; otherwise SQLite FTS5 is selected.
exit_criteria.hollow_control: backend name or novelty cannot substitute for metrics

exit_criteria.claim: Migration preserves v1 bytes and hashes, emits explicit parent provenance, and never maps legacy preflight to CQ-0/CQ-1/PU pass.
exit_criteria.hollow_control: missing oracle/architecture fields remain unmapped and block admit

exit_criteria.claim: Unknown legacy fields are listed rather than silently dropped, and critical unmapped fields derive needs-enrichment.
exit_criteria.hollow_control: legacy packet with unknown field cannot produce complete migration

milestones.title: Full v2 materialization and adversarial E2E
deliverables: fresh clone and projection rebuild proof

exit_criteria.claim: All four inputs produce standalone v2 repos that reason, perceive, execute one admitted slice, gate CQ-0, create a candidate, project async evidence, rebuild progress/RAG, and stop at human admission.
exit_criteria.hollow_control: good/hollow/stale/scope-drift controls have opposite expected outcomes

exit_criteria.claim: Seed reset reconstructs ontology/template bytes while exporting or preserving domain-run and user-owned modifications without deletion.
exit_criteria.hollow_control: domain change in PROMPT.md is classified as drift, never silently retained as ontology

exit_criteria.claim: Human admits v2 only after all milestone evidence is current and no critical blind spot or unmapped migration field remains.
exit_criteria.hollow_control: green scripts alone cannot set admitted
